name: How do wood transition strips contribute to the longevity of my flooring?

mainEntity.name: How do wood transition strips contribute to the longevity of my flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood transition strips play a vital role in extending the lifespan of your flooring by protecting vulnerable edges. Without them, the raw edges of flooring materials, especially engineered wood or laminate, can be prone to chipping, fraying, or lifting due to foot traffic, cleaning, or impacts. They also cover expansion gaps, which are necessary for flooring to expand and contract with humidity and temperature changes. By covering these gaps, the strips prevent debris from accumulating and maintain the structural integrity of the installation, ensuring your floors stay in good condition longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: They protect flooring edges from damage and cover necessary expansion gaps, preventing debris and maintaining structural integrity.
